title: Edit Staff Member never turns Technician on from the role
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician off, enrolled at the test location only.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  2. In Role, pick "Technician".
  3. In Role, pick "Foreman".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The window shows Time Clock on and Technician off.

Step 2:

  • Role shows Technician.
  • Technician stays off.

Step 3:

  • Role shows Foreman.
  • Technician stays off.
  • Technician is not grayed out.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member)

  • S1-E1: “In Edit Staff Member, changing the staff member's role to any role other than the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role leaves Technician as it is. Picking the built-in Technician or Foreman role does not turn it on; the pre-fill (S1-R3) is for new staff only.”
  • S1-R3: “In the New Staff Member window, Technician is pre-filled from the role shown: on when the role is the built-in Technician or the built-in Foreman role and Time Clock is on, otherwise off. Every other role pre-fills off, including Parts Technician and every custom role, even one made from Technician or Foreman. The pre-fill runs when the window opens and again each time the role or Time Clock is changed, until the user switches Technician by hand. From then on the user's choice wins: changing the role or Time Clock no longer pre-fills it, though S1-R4 and S1-N1 still turn it off, and only the user turns it back on. The toggle as shown is what is saved. Edit Staff Member never pre-fills (S1-E1).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "2 Turn Technician on for a staff member", pictures "Technician off" (This build) and "Technician role picked" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p2-05-after-technician-off.png
  • tt-p2-03-after-technician-role-picked.png

The design's own words:

  • “Technician is off: on release day it was turned on only for people who, in the last 90 days, had time on a work order, lead or are on a line of an open work order, or are billable. She was none of those.”
  • “Time Clock on and the built-in Technician role picked: Technician switches on by itself. The built-in Foreman role does the same; every other role, including Parts Technician and custom roles, leaves it off.”
  • “Changing the role or Time Clock sets it again from the role, until the user switches Technician by hand: from then on their choice wins. Edit Staff Member never does this.”
